reviewNotes: Reviewed every one of 418 exported speech keys from 100 cards against data/real-conversation-400-1.json vocabulary readings and furigana. Sentence/cloze prompts and full-sentence correct-answer explanations use 1.0; individual words and short choice groups use 0.85. Topic/contrast は -> わ checked by exact key and occurrence, including では and short 最近は/普通は/最後は/途中は choices. Lexical はなす/はなせます/はなしましょう/はなしかた, はる, はっせい, はじめて, はんたい and しゅくはく retained. Directional へ -> え only in station/Osaka/family-home/bank/Tokyo-direction sentence prompts; lexical へんこう, しゅうへん, へや and このへん retained. All を are object particles -> お. Corrected explanation readings 外国人 from がいこくにん to がいこくじん and 道 from どう to みち using each card’s accepted vocabulary reading and context. Katakana converted to hiragana with long vowels/gemination preserved (こんびに, れぽーと, ちぇっくいん, ほてる, ほーむ). Added final punctuation to fragments. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified. Batch 1: replaced explanations for q001–q020 with contextual meaning, construction and distractor comparisons. Reviewed explicit source annotations and contextual は→わ, を→お, へ→え before generating sentence explanations at 1.0. Readings include 出身しゅっしん, 香港ほんこん, 接客せっきゃく, 趣味しゅみ, 性格せいかく, 共通点きょうつうてん, 特徴とくちょう and 麺料理めんりょうり. Lexical kana and sentence punctuation retained. No audible listening or pitch verification claimed. Explicitly checked lexical 好む → このむ in q004 and q014; removed a repeated topic particle from the quoted heading in q018. Explanations removed from all vocabulary-only cards at the user’s request. Retained exactly the existing reviewed prompts, choice lists and vocabulary recordings.
